221 /**
222 * @brief Function call operator to access the view/array.
223 *
224 * @details Depending on the type of the calling object and the given arguments, this function call does the following:
225 * - If any of the arguments is lazy, an nda::clef::expr with the nda::clef::tags::function tag is returned.
226 * - If no arguments are given, a full view of the calling object is returned:
227 * - If the calling object itself or its value type is const, a view with a const value type is returned.
228 * - Otherwise, a view with a non-const value type is returned.
229 * - If the number of arguments is equal to the rank of the calling object and all arguments are convertible to `long`,
230 * a single element is accessed:
231 * - If the calling object is a view or an lvalue, a (const) reference to the element is returned.
232 * - Otherwise, a copy of the element is returned.
233 * - Otherwise a slice of the calling object is returned with the same value type and accessor and owning policies as
234 * the calling object. The algebra of the slice is the same as well, except if a 1-dimensional slice of a matrix is
235 * taken. In this case, the algebra is changed to 'V'.
236 *
237 * @tparam Ts Types of the function arguments.
238 * @param idxs Multi-dimensional index consisting of `long`, `nda::range`, `nda::range::all_t`, nda::ellipsis or lazy
239 * arguments.
240 * @return Result of the function call depending on the given arguments and type of the view/array.
241 */
242 template <typename... Ts>
243 FORCEINLINE decltype(auto) operator()(Ts const &...idxs) const & noexcept(has_no_boundcheck) {
244 static_assert((rank == -1) or (sizeof...(Ts) == rank) or (sizeof...(Ts) == 0) or (ellipsis_is_present<Ts...> and (sizeof...(Ts) <= rank + 1)),
245 "Error in array/view: Incorrect number of parameters in call operator");
246 919502 return call<Algebra, false>(*this, idxs...);
247 }
